query: SELECT 'frpm', COUNT(*) FROM frpm UNION ALL SELECT 'satscores', COUNT(*) FROM satscores UNION ALL SELECT 'schools', COUNT(*) FROM schools
result: frpm 9986 rows; satscores 2269 rows; schools 17686 rows
validation_method: read-only row counts per table

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN School IS NULL OR School='' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE substr(CDSCode,8,7)='0000000'; and the same predicate over all of schools
result: 1369 of 17686 schools records have the CDS school portion 0000000, and all 1369 of them have an empty School name; exactly 1369 records in the whole table have an empty School name. Their district type codes include 52 (713), 54 (349), 56 (123), 98 (77), 00 (60) and 02 (40).
validation_method: counts with complementary predicates confirming the two sets coincide

query: SELECT CDSCode, substr(CDSCode,1,2), substr(CDSCode,3,5), substr(CDSCode,8,7) FROM schools WHERE County='Alameda' LIMIT 3
result: 01100170109835 decomposes to county 01, district 10017 and school 0109835; the district record 01100170000000 decomposes to county 01, district 10017 and school 0000000. All 17686 school codes are 14 characters long.
validation_method: positional decomposition of the identifier and length check

query: cross-table membership counts of CDS codes between frpm, satscores and schools
result: all 9986 frpm codes exist in schools.CDSCode; 2058 of 2269 satscores codes exist in schools.CDSCode, leaving 211 unmatched codes all of length 13; 45 frpm rows belong to district/agency records; 467 district-level SAT rows join to district records while no district-level row joins to a school-site record
validation_method: set membership counts across tables

query: SELECT rtype, COUNT(*) FROM satscores GROUP BY rtype; and joins of each level against the school register
result: rtype S has 1749 rows and rtype D has 520 rows. Every D row that joins to schools joins to a record whose CDS school portion is 0000000 (467 rows); no D row joins to a school-site record. 1591 S rows join to school-site records.
validation_method: grouped counts combined with join-level verification

query: SELECT SUM(AvgScrMath IS NULL), SUM(AvgScrWrite IS NULL), SUM(NumGE1500 IS NULL) FROM satscores; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr=0
result: 596 rows have null AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite and NumGE1500; 218 rows have NumTstTakr equal to zero; 1537 rows have AvgScrMath above 400
validation_method: null counts and threshold counts

query: SELECT cds, sname, NumGE1500, NumTstTakr, 1.0*NumGE1500/NumTstTakr FROM satscores WHERE NumTstTakr>0 ORDER BY 5 ASC LIMIT 3
result: the smallest computable ratios are zero, produced by rows such as a school with NumTstTakr 6 and NumGE1500 null; the ratio is defined only within a row and only when the test-taker count is positive
validation_method: computed ratio ordering confirming the derivation and its undefined cases

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `Enrollment (K-12)`<>`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM frpm
result: 6460 of 9986 rows report different K-12 and ages 5-17 enrolment values; 14 rows have a null ages 5-17 enrolment and no row has a null K-12 enrolment
validation_method: row-level comparison of the two enrolment columns

query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN `Free Meal Count (K-12)`<>`FRPM Count (K-12)` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)`<>`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM frpm
result: 9352 rows differ between the K-12 free meal count and the K-12 FRPM count; 9305 rows differ on the ages 5-17 basis; 56 rows have a null K-12 free meal count
validation_method: row-level comparison of free-meal and FRPM counts

query: SELECT MIN(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`), MAX(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) FROM frpm; and a comparison against the count ratio
result: the stored rate ranges from 0.00176 to 1.0, i.e. a fraction; a row storing 0.519779208831647 corresponds to a free meal count of 565 over an enrolment of 1087, which is about 52 percent
validation_method: range check plus recomputation of the ratio from the underlying counts

query: SELECT OpenDate, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
result: 1980-07-01 appears 10679 times, empty/null 1369, and the next most frequent values are individual dates in the 2000s with counts of 55 or fewer, confirming 1980-07-01 as a systemic default rather than an observed opening wave
validation_method: value frequency distribution showing the sentinel value dominating

query: SELECT StatusType, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1; and the same over schools joined to frpm; plus a count of null ClosedDate
result: Active 11708, Closed 4518, Merged 1448, Pending 12; within the meal file Active 9846 and Closed 140; ClosedDate is null for 11992 records
validation_method: grouped status counts and null counts

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE Street<>StreetAbr; and null counts for Street, City, Zip, State and their mailing counterparts
result: StreetAbr differs from Street for 15221 of 17686 records; Street is null for 294, Zip for 293, City for 293, State for 293, MailZip for 292 and MailState for 292 records
validation_method: row comparison of the address variants and null counts

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE AdmEmail1 NOT LIKE '%_@_%.__%' (repeated for slots 2 and 3); and a lookup of a name in slot 1
result: zero malformed addresses in all three slots, so every populated administrator address contains a local part, an '@' and a dotted domain; a name lookup returns values such as first name Ricci, last name Ulrich and the address ricciulrich@cusd.com
validation_method: pattern-based validity check across all slots plus a name probe

query: SELECT MIN(Longitude), MAX(Longitude), MAX(abs(Longitude)) FROM schools
result: longitude ranges from -124.28481 to -83.781133, with the greatest absolute value 124.28481 belonging to schools in Petrolia; all longitudes are negative
validation_method: range and absolute-value extremes check

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City='Monterey'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE County='Monterey'; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE City='Monterey' AND SOC='66'
result: Monterey is the City of 16 school records and the County of 247 school records; only 1 high school has City Monterey, whereas 5 high schools in County Monterey exceed 800 free meals for ages 5-17
validation_method: comparison of the value domains of the city and county columns for the same place name

query: SELECT GSoffered, GSserved, COUNT(*) FROM schools GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30; and blank counts; and COUNT(*) WHERE GSoffered<>GSserved
result: both columns blank for 3882 records; common spans K-5 (2521), K-6 (2018), 9-12 (1538), 6-8 (968), K-8 (942), 7-8 (355), K-12 (293); GSoffered blank for 3882, GSserved blank for 5743; the two differ for 2487 records
validation_method: grouped span values, blank counts and column comparison

query: SELECT DISTINCT `Low Grade` FROM frpm ORDER BY 1; and null counts for both grade columns
result: low grade values are Adult, K, P and the numeric grades 1 through 12; neither grade column has a null value in any of the 9986 rows
validation_method: distinct value listing and null counts

query: SELECT `Academic Year`, COUNT(*) FROM frpm GROUP BY 1
result: a single value, 2014-2015, on all 9986 rows
validation_method: grouped value count

query: SELECT schools.Charter, frpm.`Charter School (Y/N)`, COUNT(*) FROM schools JOIN frpm USING CDSCode GROUP BY 1,2
result: both indicators agree as 1 on 1163 joined rows and as 0 on 8771 rows, disagree on 7 rows, and are blank on 45 rows
validation_method: cross-table agreement count of the two charter indicators

query: SELECT schools.County, frpm.`County Name` FROM schools JOIN frpm USING CDSCode WHERE schools.County<>frpm.`County Name` LIMIT 5
result: no joined row disagrees on the county name, so the meal file copy is a faithful duplicate; the district name likewise agrees, while the school name copy differs on some rows because the meal file retains older school names
validation_method: cross-table equality check of the denormalised name columns
